scope: Accept pending single/multi-product quote plus bounded contact form before partial contact handlers
Validate entire form then delegate addition to existing price/stock/quantity/attribute logic
Later courtesy does not duplicate purchased items; final order confirmation separate
Price change or unavailable product retains valid contact but does not add an unauthorized product
limits: Only pending quote without competing selection and delimited acceptance/contact fields
Arbitrary mixed instructions and multiple-combo reconstruction not covered
New journeys use fixed delivery fee, mocked external services and mocked agent; no live customer conversion evidence
